originality.rationale: Comparison of statements and implications: Efthymiou gives influence spectral bounds and mixing for general hard-core graphs, not entries of the inverse ordinary covariance; Marsman et al. give Bayesian Ising interaction-edge inference, where canonical interactions are not this covariance inverse. Crown deterministic graph results and complete-graph monomer-dimer matching precision use distinct mathematical objects. No direct domination of all three fugacity thresholds/all-positive cutoff was found; an earlier implicit application of independence-polynomial methods remains possible. The crown independence polynomial itself is already recorded by MathWorld and is not treated as novel; obtaining the entry of its multivariate precision and the exact sign cutoff is the additional claim.

value.rationale: A natural full-order linear partial-correlation diagnostic disagrees with both negative marginal covariance and exact graphical conditional independence. Two explicit positive fugacity phase boundaries followed by an all-parameter cutoff at the minimal sixth pair give a finite, complete, motivated structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The precise n=6 cutoff could benchmark interpretations of inverse covariance for constrained binary graphical models.
